strategy_roster.name: SMC
strategy_roster.notes: The 8-bar Donchian midpoint approximates premium/discount zones and SMA(50) supplies the documented trend filter. Order-block support/resistance and the short branch are not directly expressible; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: NTK 07 Range Trader
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar high break with EMA(20) confirmation approximates the range-edge stop-order branch. The range-mode state, pending orders, session hours, pyramiding, and point-based stops/targets are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Exponential MA Rounding Channel
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(12) plus/minus one ATR(12) approximates the rounded exponential-MA channel and its opposite exit. Tick rounding, the 1000/2000-tick stop/target, and four-hour scheduling are not representable as percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: EMA 5-8-13 with ADX Filter
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(5)/EMA(8) crossover and the documented ADX threshold 20 are direct; EMA(13) supplies the exit. The opposite short exit and source timeframe details are omitted, and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Enhanced Ichimoku Cloud
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma(close,7) > sma(close,211) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,25) and close > ema(close,171)
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(7)/SMA(211) and the EMA(171) filter approximate Ichimoku span, Tenkan/Kijun, and long-term trend agreement; the prior 25-bar high is the breakout. Displacement, lagging spans, and start/end dates are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: DVD 100-50 Cent
strategy_roster.notes: A pullback toward SMA(20) that remains above the prior 20-bar low approximates a contrarian limit-order setup. Four-timeframe scoring, 100-level grid placement, order expiry, and 210/18-pip protection are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Plan X Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: A 0.25% distance from SMA(20) is a normalized proxy for the documented 25-pip long target; the inverse band is the short-style exit reference. Anchor/session timing, instrument pip conversion, initial stop, and trailing steps are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Simple Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.notes: The first valid positive-price bar approximates the source's one-time initial long entry, while falling below EMA(20) proxies a trailing stop. The first-bar state, fixed TrailPoints distance, and continuous trailing updates are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: RRS Non-Directional
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy alternates hedged basket modes and has no deterministic long market signal in the single OHLCV series, so the impossible guard avoids fabrication. Virtual/classic protection, risk shutdown, and order-mode state are outside the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Bezier Standard Deviation
strategy_roster.notes: A standard-deviation(9) cross above its rolling mean approximates expansion from a volatility trough, with the inverse cross as the opposite exit. The local-neighbor minimum/maximum test and four-hour scheduling are not directly available.
